id.description: When not null, this is the call queue or hunt group's unique identifier.

type.description: When not null, indicates whether a call queue or hunt group has been selected.

name.description: When not null, indicates the call queue's or hunt group's name.

phoneNumber.description: When not null, indicates the call queue's or hunt group's phone number.

extension.description: When not null, indicates the call queue's or hunt group's extension number.
